AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  JUNE 18, 2019
REGULAR MEETING
  6:00 PM
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Margarita L. Rios, Mayor
  Luigi Vernola, Vice Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Councilmember
  Jennifer Perez, Councilmember
  Leonard Shryock, Councilmember
 Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
 the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
 subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
 minutes.

 Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
 certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
 matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

 Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
 meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
 devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
 documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
 Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
 that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

 Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
 has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

 Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
 during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
 telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meeting of June 4,
  2019. 825-04

  Report

  2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period May 5, 2019 – May 18,
  2019, in the total amount of $909,488.67. 630

  Report

  3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period May

  Report

  4.  CLAIMS AGAINST THE CITY – Staff recommends City Council deny the claims filed by Viridiana

  Report

  5.  PLANNING COMMISSION SYNOPSIS – JUNE 12, 2019 – Receive and File. 320

  6.  RESOLUTION NO. 19-34 – AUTHORIZING THE CITY’S APPLICATION FOR GRANT FUNDS FOR

  HERMOSILLO PARK. 623

  7.  AGREEMENT AMENDMENT NO. 6 – PARKING CONCEPTS INCORPORATED FOR PARKING
  MANAGEMENT SERVICES – EXTENDING TERM TO JUNE 30, 2020 – Staff recommends City

  adjustment with Parking Concepts, Inc., for an additional one-year term beginning July 1, 2019; and
  authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the
  City Attorney. 920-04

  Report

  8.  RESOLUTION NO. 19-37 – SUPPORTIVE SERVICES PROGRAM GRANT AGREEMENT – Staff

   2019/20. 425-02-05

  Report

9.  PROJECT NO. 7445 - AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR WELL NO. 4 REHABILITATION PROJECT - Staff
  recommends City Council award a contract to General Pump Company in the amount of $114,320 for
  the the rehabilitation of Well No. 4; and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and any
  amendments, provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the
  City Attorney. 1005-04-7445

  Report

10. PROJECT NO. 7522 – AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR ENGINEERING SERVICE OF FISCAL YEAR
  (FY) 2018/19 SEWER MANHOLE INSPECTION PROJECT - Staff recommends City Council award a
  contract to Cannon in the amount of $255,894 for professional engineering services for the Fiscal Year
  2018/19 sewer manhole inspection project starting in July 2019 and ending March 2020; and authorize
  the City Manager to execute the agreement and any amendments, provided there is funding in the
  budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 1005-04-7522

  Report

11. AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR PREVENTATIVE MAINTENANCE AND REPAIR SERVICES FOR
  HEATING, VENTILATION, AND AIR CONDITIONING (HVAC) UNITS CITYWIDE – Staff recommends
  City Council award a contract to Tri-West Mechanical, Inc. in the amount of $60,699 for preventative
  maintenance and repair services for heating, ventilation, and air conditioning units citywide for the term
  of July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2022; with the option to extend for two (2) additional one (1) year
  periods; and authorize the City Manager to execute the contract and any amendments provided there
  is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney.

  Report

12. APPROVAL OF MUNICIPAL LAW ENFORCEMENT SERVICES AGREEMENT RENEWAL - Staff
  recommends City Council approve the agreement with County of Los Angeles for the period of July 1,
  2019 through June 30, 2024; and authorize the City Manager to execute the renewal agreement on
  behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 730-01

  Report

13. RESOLUTION NO. 19-39 – APPROVING AGREEMENTS FOR NORWALK SENIOR NUTRITION
  PROGRAM SERVICES FOR FISCAL YEAR 2019/20 – Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No.19-39, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK APPROVING AGREEMENTS WITH THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY WORKFORCE
  DEVELOPMENT, AGING COMMUNITY SERVICES AND BETTER 4 YOU MEALS CATERER
  FOR ELDERLY NUTRITION PROGRAM SERVICES FOR FISCAL YEAR 2019/20; and

  b.  approve an agreement with the Los Angeles County Workforce Development, Aging Community
  Services to fund the Elderly Nutrition Program in the amount of $699,999 from July 1, 2019
  through June 30, 2020;

  c.  approve an agreement with Better 4 You Meals to provide food services for the nutrition program
  from July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020 not to exceed $430,862; and

  d.  authorize the City Manager to execute the agreements and any amendments, provided there is
  funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in forms approved by the City Attorney. 425-02-03

  Report

14. PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION APPROVAL OF BLUE CURB AT 11116 ROSECRANS AVENUE - No
